env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_ROUTER_COOKIE_AUTH
env_var_specs.description: Synology Router session cookie obtained via auth login

tools.name: access-control_groups-list
tools.description: Returns array of access control groups with member devices and usage stats.

tools.name: devices_list
tools.description: Returns array of devices with IP, MAC, hostname, and online status.

tools.name: dns_ddns-records-list
tools.description: Returns array of DDNS records with update status.

tools.name: dns_external-ip-get
tools.description: Returns object with current external (WAN) IP address.

tools.name: firewall_rules-list
tools.description: Returns array of firewall policy route rules.

tools.name: firewall_rules-set
tools.description: Replace all firewall rules. Full replace, not patch.

tools.name: mesh_nodes-list
tools.description: Returns array of mesh nodes with status, rate, and device count.

tools.name: mesh_system-info-get
tools.description: Returns object with router model, firmware, serial, uptime.

tools.name: qos_rules-list
tools.description: Returns array of QoS bandwidth rules per device.

tools.name: session_auth-login
tools.description: Authenticate and obtain a session ID. Returns object with sid.

tools.name: session_auth-logout
tools.description: Destroy the current SRM session.

tools.name: smartwan_smart-wan-config-get
tools.description: Returns object with Smart WAN config: failover mode, load-balancing, interfaces.

tools.name: smartwan_smart-wan-config-set
tools.description: Update Smart WAN config.

tools.name: smartwan_smart-wan-gateway-list
tools.description: Returns array of Smart WAN gateways with status and health.

tools.name: system_info-query
tools.description: Returns object with available SRM API namespaces. No auth required.

tools.name: traffic_get
tools.description: Returns array of traffic per device sorted by download with human-readable bandwidth.

tools.name: utilization_get
tools.description: Returns object with router CPU, memory, and network utilization.

tools.name: wan_status-get
tools.description: Returns object with WAN status: IP, gateway, DNS, connection uptime.

tools.name: wifi_settings-get
tools.description: Returns array of Wi-Fi profiles: SSIDs, security, band, radio config.

tools.name: wifi_settings-set
tools.description: Update Wi-Fi profiles. Full replace — read current first.

tools.name: wol_device-add
tools.description: Register a MAC for Wake-on-LAN.

tools.name: wol_devices-list
tools.description: Returns array of WOL-registered devices with MAC and hostname.

tools.name: wol_wake
tools.description: Send WOL magic packet to wake a device.

tools.name: search
tools.description: FTS across synced data. Requires sync first.

params.name: query
params.description: FTS5 query: AND, OR, NOT, phrases

tools.name: sql
tools.description: Read-only SQL on local DB. Requires sync first.

tools.name: context
tools.description: API context: resource taxonomy, auth, tips. Call first.

tools.name: network_overview
tools.description: Single-call network snapshot: WAN IP, device counts, top talkers, Wi-Fi SSIDs, and mesh health.

tools.name: device_lookup
tools.description: Find a device by hostname, IP, or MAC across synced and live data.

params.name: query
params.description: Hostname, IP, or MAC to search

tools.name: busiest_devices
tools.description: Top bandwidth consumers aggregated from traffic data. Returns ranked list with human-readable sizes.

tools.name: router_health
tools.description: Router health: CPU, memory, WAN status, device counts, and mesh node status in one call.

tools.name: security_audit
tools.description: Firewall rules, Wi-Fi security, access control groups, and open ports summary.

tools.name: wake_device
tools.description: Wake a device by hostname or MAC. Registers if needed, then sends WOL packet.

tools.name: stale_resources
tools.description: List synced resources older than a threshold. Helps decide when to re-sync.

tools.name: wifi_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable a Wi-Fi SSID by name without replacing the full profile.

params.name: enable
params.description: true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: device_online
tools.description: Check if a specific device is currently online by hostname, IP, or MAC.

tools.name: mesh_health
tools.description: Mesh node status with connected device counts and link quality.

tools.name: dns_summary
tools.description: External IP plus all DDNS records in one call.

tools.name: reboot_check
tools.description: Check if router needs a reboot: uptime, firmware version, and pending changes.
